native_history.summary: Main-page file pilot with native owners. Schema-derived types, tag import and missing gates remained unqualified; file/model checks were not panel acceptance.
Seven-page operator reconstruction. Visual PASS withdrawn after background/layer defects; button enum assumptions later withdrawn too.
Text-free DIB/background and actual state/layer preview. Numeric limits and button behavior defects remained separate open issues.
Diagnostic numeric limits: one999upper-limit change reduced13reported errors to12; no safe physical-range, full fit or generic TIME acceptance.
Source witnesses corrected momentary1.3/maintained1.4. TIME card temporarily removed without changing original TIME XML; mode writes non-atomic.
Separate source-level millisecond interface branch. Source-backed candidate, not a new generic PLC bridge or vendor export.
Four time-card owners restored onto corrected buttons; real helper leaves added, original TIME and surviving object/XML bytes retained.
Startup/heartbeat and draft/readback proposal. Shared-draft race candidate rejected; macro acceptance later withdrawn and globals rolled back.
Vendor-resaved initial/clock preserved; three button parsed operands changed. Five programs/40records roundtripped; no live write/cadence proof.
Visible source plus parsed Application rewrite failed with five Error109. Acceptance withdrawn; failed archive and later delivery-location bytes differ.

Field0 retained and29parsed operands qualified. Human CompilePASS lacked exact compiled-native linkage; live Error7/HB0/stale bare descriptors remained, final STOP. MeMeCode-only explanation withdrawn.
Only Initial/Clock cleared, three BeforeExec retained. PLC pairing/rearm/live acceptance open. Reviewed archive passes9negatives; other copy fails whole-section drift.
Sixteen buttons/32fields rebound to command inputs; physical/status fields remained Read. Request is not motion. Reviewed archive passes11negatives; other copy fails whole-payload reverse.
Readonly current fault/home/drive roles. No history/ACK/reset engine, reliable mode transaction or transport-cache suppression; active code0possible.
Simplified layout and passive code reference replaced corrupted sparse mappings; raw codes retained. Text simplification does not authorize style flattening.
Exact style-only transfer with sequential aesthetic reviews/preservation negatives. Unproved gradient/radius/DPI/native pixels and runtime remain unqualified.

planning_history.author_review: Filtered generic HMI intents from the complete root-collected record;39HMI user messages selected. Machine PLC narrative excluded.
generic_lessons: Coordinate native file MCP work with separate manual vendor import/compile acceptance.
Clearly distinguish input/display, request/readback and physical feedback.
Readable labels and separate units; value range, width, gain and digit-fit matter.
Large hit areas and consistent grids; do not fill blank space with invented controls.
Canonical CSV is a technical ledger, not a vendor import file.
Missing tags/counters stay disabled; no fictional polling counters.
Momentary JOG and maintained toggles require explicit behavioral intent.
Preview is not native fidelity; preserve controlled revisions and retractions.

document_history.summary: Canonical object/tag/migration ledger and measured layout; simulated transaction model. Unique-tag and object counts differ; design references are not a compiled native project.
Recipe/motor/service consolidation and clear input/display distinction. Draft/apply differs from readback; analog/reserved channels stay explicit.
Simplified ramps/service hierarchy. Local drafts need a real dispatcher/readback contract; unsupported browser/native writes refuse.
Unavailable counters/full servo feedback/first-fault latch remain missing or disabled. No invented polling counters or alternative feedback; full acceptance withheld.
